notes:
Short summary: Aurum builds a GitHub-style PR review copilot embedded in VSCode and the web UI. Primary asks: low-latency streaming in the editor, deterministic model/version pinning for reproducible comments, reranking to reduce noisy autofill, and near real-time diff summarization at scale.

POC specifics and requirements: 
- Workload: mix of small PR diffs (5-200 LOC) and large monorepo changes (up to 8k-line diffs). Need adaptive batching.
- Latency/throughput targets: p50 <= 150ms for single-file diffs in IDE flows; throughput 60 reqs/s sustained for CI bulk runs.
- Cost sensitivity: tight unit economics for free tier; budget-conscious for paid plans. Interested in Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching).
- Models: prefer open weights (Llama-derivative) with ability to pin exact version; fallback to smaller model for noisy diffs.
- Observability: token-level cost breakdown, per-route latency, tracing hooks for sample diffs.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS, audit logs, and US data residency. Legal asks about retention window for user prompts/PR text.
